items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] So where were we? We were talking about how Jelly used to dress.

ctx.x: Kid did me. That's right. That's right. That's right. So where were we? We were talking about how Jelly used to dress. Oh, but yeah. Yeah. How did you use to dress in those days?
Well, I went on with the rest of them, you know.
